flow notice.followup v1
title: notice followup
start: send
stage notice: notice
step send [Action] send
  stage: notice
  does: Asks `messaging.notice` to do something. It contacts a person. It only goes out inside the delivery window contact hours. It sends `case_ref`. If the call fails for a passing reason it tries again, up to 2 attempts in all.
  next: When it succeeds: go to await reply
  onError: If it fails: go to failed
step await_reply [Repeated read] await reply
  stage: -
  does: Reads `intake.replies` again and again until `state` is `answered`. It reads after 1 hour and doubles the wait each time, for at most 6 hours. The wait never grows beyond 4 hours. It sends `case_ref` and `replies`. It keeps `replies`.
  next: When the answer says it is done: go to done
  onError: If it fails: go to failed
  onExpired: If the time runs out: go to expired
step done [End] done
  stage: -
  does: Ends the case with the result answered.
step expired [End] expired
  stage: -
  does: Ends the case with the result expired.
step failed [End] failed
  stage: -
  does: Ends the case with the result failed.
